text: _Culture._ The feeds of the amethyaites should be flown in autumn as they set up to remain a whole year in the ground if kept till the living. When the plants come up, nothing else is necefitary than to keep them clear of weeds, and to thin them where they are too clede. They ought to be down where they are to re main, as they do not thrive when transparent.

parsed.modern: Culture. The seeds of the amethysts should be sown in autumn as they are apt to remain a whole year in the ground if kept till the spring. When the plants come up, nothing else is necessary than to keep them clear of weeds, and to thin them where they are too close. They ought to be sown where they are to remain, as they do not thrive when transplanted.
